interface.longDescription: A local-first Power BI workbench for analysts, executives, developers, and Fabric owners. Understand KPI trust, review PBIP/TMDL safely, and create release and operations evidence without modifying binary PBIX files. Live Desktop and Fabric snapshot workflows are explicitly read-only.
